name: Portuguese and French translation with a must-keep glossary
job: The site publishes its pages in Portuguese and French. Product names and defined terms in the glossary must stay exactly as written in English.
note: The language checks are rough: they look for common words of the target language and for English words that should have gone. A person should read the output for quality; these checks only catch the obvious failures.

policy.name: Site translator
policy.summary: Policy for the Site translator eval suite.
instructions: These glossary terms must stay exactly as written, in English, never translated: Sovereign Website; Agent Behaviour Policy; sgit.

checks.why: never output anything shaped like a key

cases.prompt:
Translate into European Portuguese:

This Sovereign Website runs its agents under an Agent Behaviour Policy. Every change is stored in sgit and checked by a person before it goes live.

checks.why: glossary term "Agent Behaviour Policy" kept exactly
no untranslated English words from the source

cases.prompt:
Translate into European Portuguese:

Visitors can read the Agent Behaviour Policy on every page. The Sovereign Website keeps no cookies, and its history lives in sgit.

checks.why: glossary term "Agent Behaviour Policy" kept exactly
no untranslated English words from the source
